intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene on chromosome Xp21.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The paper shows hemizygous CFAP47 mutations cause X-linked MMAF/asthenoteratozoospermia. The SPGFX3 label is OMIM's own name for this disorder.

checks.claim: The CFAP47 gene is located on chromosome Xp21.
checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene
checks.explanation: The deletion removing CFAP47 maps to Xp21.1, which places the gene at Xp21.

paragraphs.text: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is a form of male infertility marked by asthenoteratozoospermia. Sperm motility is reduced and the sperm flagella show abnormal shapes, which places the disorder within the spectrum of multiple morphologic abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF).

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is a form of male infertility characterized by asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility.
checks.explanation: The title states that the disorder is male infertility with asthenoteratozoospermia.

checks.claim: In X-linked spermatogenic failure-3, sperm motility is reduced.
checks.evidence_quote: Asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella (MMAF) has been identified as a sub-type of male infertility.
checks.explanation: Asthenozoospermia means reduced sperm motility, and the affected men had asthenoteratozoospermia.

checks.claim: In X-linked spermatogenic failure-3, the sperm flagella show abnormal morphology.
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: MMAF is defined by abnormally shaped sperm flagella, and all affected men showed it.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 falls within the spectrum of multiple morphologic abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF).
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: The paper places the affected men within MMAF.

paragraphs.text: SPGFX3 is inherited in an X-linked pattern. Affected men carry hemizygous mutations in CFAP47, an X-chromosome gene (Liu et al., 2021).

checks.claim: SPGFX3 is inherited in an X-linked pattern.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The paper explicitly calls the disorder X-linked.

checks.claim: Men affected with SPGFX3 carry hemizygous mutations in CFAP47.
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: Every affected man carried a hemizygous CFAP47 variant.

checks.claim: CFAP47 is located on the X chromosome.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The paper describes CFAP47 as an X-linked gene.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) studied infertile men with asthenoteratozoospermia using whole-exome sequencing and found hemizygous mutations in the CFAP47 gene. In the sperm of the affected men, CFAP47 protein was reduced or absent. The authors linked the loss of CFAP47 to defective flagellar structure and reduced sperm motility.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) performed whole-exome sequencing in infertile men with asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: we conducted whole-exome sequencing (WES) and identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: Whole-exome sequencing was done in men with MMAF, and a second cohort was of men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) identified hemizygous mutations in the CFAP47 gene in infertile men with asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The paper reports hemizygous missense variants plus a hemizygous deletion of the whole gene.

checks.claim: CFAP47 protein was reduced or absent in the sperm of the men with CFAP47 mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays revealed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men harboring deleterious missense variants of CFAP47.
checks.explanation: The paper reports reduced CFAP47 levels in the three men with missense variants. It does not say the protein was absent, and it describes no protein testing for the man with the deletion.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) linked loss of CFAP47 to defective sperm flagellar structure.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: MMAF is a defect of flagellar structure, and the mice also had abnormal flagellar morphology.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) linked loss of CFAP47 to reduced sperm motility.
checks.evidence_quote: the adult males of which were sterile and presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement
checks.explanation: The paper links CFAP47 loss to reduced motility (asthenozoospermia) in both men and mice.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) reported that male mice with Cfap47 mutations had reduced sperm motility and lower fertility, a phenotype resembling the asthenoteratozoospermia seen in the affected men.

checks.claim: Male mice with Cfap47 mutations had reduced sperm motility.
checks.evidence_quote: the adult males of which were sterile and presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement
checks.explanation: The paper states that the mutant male mice had reduced sperm motility.

checks.claim: Male mice with Cfap47 mutations had reduced fertility.
checks.evidence_quote: We also generated a Cfap47-mutated mouse model, the adult males of which were sterile
checks.explanation: The paper says the male mice were sterile, which is stronger than 'lower fertility'. Fertility was rescued only by ICSI.

checks.claim: The phenotype of Cfap47-mutant male mice resembled the asthenoteratozoospermia seen in men with CFAP47 mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The mice showed reduced motility and abnormal flagella, matching the human MMAF/asthenoteratozoospermia phenotype.

references.label: Liu et al. (2021)
references.citation: Liu C, Tu C, Wang L, Wu H, Houston BJ, Mastrorosa FK, Zhang W, Shen Y, Wang J, Tian S, and others. Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility. Am J Hum Genet 108: 309-323, 2021. [PubMed: 33472045]
